mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that boosts equity market sentiment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during easing periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 4% triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as higher unemployment reduces consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a decline in housing starts and an increase in consumer spending signals a shift in demand from housing to other sectors, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above 2% month-over-month signals a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher production boosts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3% signals a tightening monetary cycle that reduces equity market liquidity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during tightening periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between an increase in payroll employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP below 2% quarter-over-quarter signals a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower GDP reduces consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between an increase in the federal funds rate and a decrease in the consumer price index signals a reduction in inflationary pressures, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
